verdict.rationale: Cubic supports several natural-language style interactions: commenting @cubic-dev-ai review this PR, replying to review comments to ask for clarification, and via its MCP server letting a coding agent be asked in natural language to check subscriptions, manage seats, or request reviews. However, these are mostly narrow, command-like phrases tied to specific GitHub PR actions rather than a general natural-language interface for the whole product. Missing for 10: a broader chat/console NL interface covering all product actions, independent hands-on evidence of open-ended NL command handling beyond documented phrases, evidence of NL steering codebase scans or wiki generation.
